
         ent  $

START    ld   (SPSTOR+1),sp
         di
         call PREPIS
         ld   sp,0
         call MAKETAB

         ld   bc,30*256+128

FILL     ld   hl,-1
         push hl
         push bc

FILL2    pop  bc
         ld   a,b
         and  c
         inc  a
         jr   z,FILLEND
         call POINT
         jr   nz,FILL2
         push bc
         call PLOT3
         pop  bc
         ld   a,b
         or   a
         jr   z,NOUP
         dec  b
         call POINT
         jr   nz,NOUP2
         push bc
NOUP2    inc  b

NOUP     ld   a,b
         cp   64
         jr   z,NODOWN
         inc  b
         call POINT
         jr   nz,NODOWN2
         push bc
NODOWN2  dec  b

NODOWN   ld   a,c
         or   a
         jr   z,NOLEFT
         dec  c
         call POINT
         jr   nz,NOLEFT2
         push bc
NOLEFT2  inc  c

NOLEFT   ld   a,c
         cp   255
         jr   z,FILL2
         inc  c
         call POINT
         jr   nz,NORIGHT2
         push bc
NORIGHT2 dec  c
         jr   FILL2

FILLEND  ld   a,4
         out  (254),a
SPSTOR   ld   sp,0
         ret

POINT    push bc
         ld   l,b
         ld   h,SCRNADRS/256
         ld   a,c
         rrca
         rrca
         rrca
         and  31
         add  a,(hl)
         inc  h
         ld   h,(hl)
         ld   l,a
         ld   b,TABLE/256
         ld   a,(bc)
         and  (hl)
         pop  bc
         ret

PLOT3    ld   l,b
         ld   h,SCRNADRS/256
         ld   a,c
         rrca
         rrca
         rrca
         and  31
         add  a,(hl)
         inc  h
         ld   h,(hl)
         ld   l,a
         ld   b,TABLE/256
         ld   a,(bc)
         xor  (hl)
         ld   (hl),a
         ret

MAKETAB  ld   b,192
         ld   de,16384
         ld   hl,SCRNADRS
MAKETAB2 ld   (hl),e
         inc  h
         ld   (hl),d
         dec  h
         inc  hl
         ex   de,hl
         call DOWNHL
         ex   de,hl
         djnz MAKETAB2
         ld   b,32
         ld   hl,TABLE
MAKETAB3 ld   (hl),128
         inc  l
         ld   (hl),64
         inc  l
         ld   (hl),32
         inc  l
         ld   (hl),16
         inc  l
         ld   (hl),8
         inc  l
         ld   (hl),4
         inc  l
         ld   (hl),2
         inc  l
         ld   (hl),1
         inc  l
         djnz MAKETAB3
         ret

PREPIS   ld   a,2
         call #1601
         ld   a,22
         rst  16
         xor  a
         rst  16
         xor  a
         rst  16
         ld   b,0
PREPIS2  ld   a,r
         and  63
         add  a,32
         rst  16
         djnz PREPIS2
         ret

DOWNHL   inc  h
         ld   a,h
         and  7
         ret  nz

         ld   a,l
         add  a,32
         ld   l,a
         ld   a,h
         jr   c,DOWNHL2
         sub  8
         ld   h,a
DOWNHL2  cp   88
         ret  c
         ld   h,64
         ret

LAST

         org  LAST/256+1*256

SCRNADRS defs 512
TABLE    defs 256
